text.content: Context

rich_text.plain_text: Context

text.content: Phase 2 of the Contigo support agent build is centred on one capability: the agent must be able to retrieve relevant information from a verified knowledge base before generating a response. It must not fabricate answers when information is missing, and it must not lose the memory behaviour established in Sprint 1.This assessment does not introduce new concepts. It is a validation gate. The agent you have built across Sprints 1 and 2 must demonstrate that all components are working together as one connected system before tools are added in Sprint 3.

text.content: When all five validation tests pass, Phase 2 is done. The memory foundation from Sprint 1 and the RAG pipeline from Sprint 2 are now working as one connected system.
